Class Player

java.lang.Object
java.util.Observable
jimpossiblemission.model.entity.Entity

jimpossiblemission.model.entity.Player
All Implemented Interfaces:
Observer, CanCollide, CanFall, CanJump
public class Player extends DynamicObject implements CanFall, CanCollide, CanJump
Player is a dynamicObject that can fall, can collide and can jump. It also can take damage from other gameObjects (Enemy)
